scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Para/Tetra/Hemi Plegic Ex-Servicemen
other_conditions: Applicant must be an ex‑serviceman suffering from paraplegia, tetraplegia or hemiplegia
Applicant must be 100 % disabled (total incapacitation) and financially penurious
For hemiplegic ex‑servicemen, disability must be confirmed 6 months after onset and the condition must not have recovered
Applicant must not be residing in paraplegic homes funded by the Government of India or the State Government
Applicant must not be receiving any financial assistance or pension from any department of the Haryana Government
Applicant must produce a certificate from the concerned District Social Welfare Officer confirming no assistance/ pension from the Social Justice & Empowerment Department of Haryana
Applicant must submit annual survival verification proof to continue receiving assistance
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month, with an annual increase of ₹400 each November.
documents_required: Certificate issued by the District Social Welfare Officer confirming no financial assistance/pension from the Social Justice & Empowerment Department of Haryana
Pre‑defined application form/template downloaded from the Antyodaya‑SARAL portal
